architecture.decision: Keep the rights and provenance machinery interoperable with established and local licenses; do not make an MNCS-specific license a prerequisite.

apache_2_0.patent_litigation_response: Section 3 terminates the patent license when the licensee initiates specified patent litigation alleging the work or a contribution infringes.
redistribution_terms: provide a copy of the license
mark modified files with change notices
preserve applicable NOTICE attributions when a NOTICE file is included
retain notice, conditions, and disclaimer in source
reproduce notice, conditions, and disclaimer in binary materials

bsd_2_clause_patent.claim_boundary: Claims licensable by the grantor that are necessarily infringed by the contribution alone or by its qualifying combination with the work to which it was added, measured when the addition occurs.
bsd_2_clause_patent.grant_condition: Irrevocable except for failure to satisfy license conditions.
bsd_2_clause_patent.patent_litigation_response: No express patent-litigation response clause appears in the identified text.

mit.notice_condition: Include the copyright and permission notices in copies or substantial portions.

open_legal_questions: Whether an MNCS-specific license is needed at all remains undecided.

Definitions, grant authority, third-party material, machine-generated ownership, jurisdiction, and enforceability require qualified review.
